genxml.title: Hub network interface field layouts, port and vector fields, and register offsets outside the census
genxml.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header, pinned linux tree (names, masks, shifts and software default constants)

struct.name: NI_RETURN_VECTOR
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header, pinned linux tree (names, masks, shifts and software default constants)
struct.doc: Return vector of a vector operation, named NI_RETURN_VECTOR in the header. The header gives no layout. The IRIX register table confirms the access.

struct.name: NI_IO_PROTECT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header, pinned linux tree (names, masks, shifts and software default constants)
struct.doc: PIO protection bits, one per region, named NI_IO_PROTECT in the header. Offset and name are from the header. The header gives neither a field layout nor a reset. The IRIX register table confirms the access.

struct.name: NI_IO_PROT_OVRRD
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header, pinned linux tree (names, masks, shifts and software default constants)
struct.doc: PIO protection override, named NI_IO_PROT_OVRRD in the header. The header gives no unlock value or behaviour, so none is imported. The IRIX register table confirms the access.

struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header, pinned linux tree (names, masks, shifts and software default constants)
struct.doc: CPU 0 PIO age control, named NI_AGE_CPU0_PIO in the header. Layout in NI_AGE_FORMAT. The IRIX register table confirms the access.

struct.name: NI_PORT_PARMS
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header, pinned linux tree (names, masks, shifts and software default constants)
struct.doc: Port parameters, named NI_PORT_PARMS in the header. Offset and name are from the header. The fields are graded on their own. The IRIX register table confirms the access.

struct.name: NI_META_ENTRY
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header, pinned linux tree (names, masks, shifts and software default constants)
struct.doc: Meta routing table entries 1 to 31, eight bytes apart from the census entry ni_meta_table0. The header gives the stride and the count of 32 entries. Access is assumed read and write. The entry width is not stated in the header and is not imported.

struct.name: NI_LOCAL_ENTRY
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header, pinned linux tree (names, masks, shifts and software default constants)
struct.doc: Local routing table entries 1 to 15, eight bytes apart from the census entry ni_local_table0. The header gives the stride and the count of 16 entries. Access is assumed read and write. The entry width is not stated in the header and is not imported.

struct.name: NI_AGE_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header: NAGE_* masks, shifts and channel names
struct.doc: Layout of each of the eight ageing registers, ni_age_cpu0_memory through ni_age_io_pio. The census names two of them. The header gives the channel field its own names and no meaning for the congestion field.

struct.name: NI_DIAG_PARMS_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header: NDP_* masks
struct.doc: Layout of the diagnostic parameters register, ni_diag_parms. The header names each bit and gives no further behaviour.

struct.name: NI_GLOBAL_PARMS_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header: NGP_* masks and shifts
struct.doc: Layout of the global link parameters register, ni_global_parms. The header's comment on the credit-timeout field repeats the wording of the field above it; the name used here is the mask's own name.

struct.name: NI_PORT_ERROR_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header: NPE_* masks and shifts
struct.doc: Layout of the port error register, ni_port_error, and of its clearing alias, ni_port_error_clear. Bit 32 is outside the header's error mask and has no name.

struct.name: NI_PORT_RESET_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header: NPR_* masks
struct.doc: Layout of the port reset register, ni_port_reset. The register is written, not read back; the header gives no read value.

struct.name: NI_PROTECTION_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header: NPROT_RESETOK
struct.doc: Layout of the protection configuration register, ni_protection.

struct.name: NI_STATUS_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header: NSRI_* masks and shifts
struct.doc: Layout of the status, revision and identity register, ni_status_rev_id. The header names the port status bits separately; this word uses the same names. The census of the shipped IRIX Origin 200/2000 kernel (the census field table) shows the register read with a shift of 8 and a nine-bit mask for the node number, a shift of 4 for the chip revision and a test of bit 17 for the region size; the header's layout agrees.

struct.name: NI_VECTOR_PARMS_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header: NVP_* masks and shifts
struct.doc: Layout of the vector routing parameters register, ni_vector_parms. The header's identifier mask covers bits 49:40. Other sources put the top bit of that field at 50; this layout follows the public header.

struct.name: NI_VECTOR_STATUS_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub network interface header: NVS_* masks and shifts
struct.doc: Layout of the vector routing status register, ni_vector_status. The source field is ten bits in the header (60:51). Another source gives it eleven bits (61:51); this layout follows the public header.
